newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nishimatsu Con falls to '97 low on sector worries.
newsitem.headline: Nishimatsu Con falls to '97 low on sector worries.

text.p: Shares of Nishimatsu Construction Co Ltd fell to a low for this calendar year on Monday morning, hurt by lingering worries over the debt-laden building sector, brokers said.
By 0137 GMT, the share price had dropped 46 yen to 642, compared with the previous low for this year of 683. The shares briefly went as low as 636 yen.
Its trading volume of 1.835 million shares was the ninth largest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

"The performance of Nishimatsu's shares has been one of the better ones in the construction sector, but worries about the industry are so strong that even it was sold," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
